scope: ERC-20 v0.7.6 pre-release noops before the evm-balances-erc20-v0.7.6 tag. No ClickHouse writes, sink changes, API cutover or full-history qualification.
range_semantics: Start inclusive, stop exclusive. Production mode processes complete 1000-block segments; noops assert acceptance, not the correctness of every balance.
window_selection: Every window of docs/prerelease-noop-windows.json as of 2026-11-05 (875).
Each chain's last complete 1000-block segment below its 2026-11-05 head, where not already in the set.
The segments of the blocks replayed for the v0.7.6 investigation (Solady pUSD and AERO, MKR burns, HEX, sUSDe, LDO, TUSD, SOS, FUN, Base's 0xb2 tokens), where not already in the set.
why_these_suffice: v0.7.6 changes only the inference (src/infer.rs), which never fails a block; block validation and the persistence rules are those of v0.7.5. The noops check that the new inference code neither panics nor fails to decode on these blocks.
